definitions.explanation: The joint connecting the foot to the leg. Literally 'foot neck.'

examples.japanese: {足首|あしくび}を{捻|ひね}ってしまいました。
{足首|あしくび}が{腫|は}れています。
{足首|あしくび}を{回|まわ}す{運動|うんどう}をしましょう。
examples.english: Let's do exercises rotating our ankles.

examples.japanese: {走|はし}っているとき{足首|あしくび}が{痛|いた}くなった。
examples.english: My ankle started hurting while I was running.

examples.japanese: {足首|あしくび}を{怪我|けが}してしまったので、{今週|こんしゅう}はサッカーの{練習|れんしゅう}を{休|やす}むことにしました。
examples.english: I injured my ankle, so I decided to take a break from soccer practice this week.

notes:
{足首|あしくび} means ankle - the joint connecting the foot to the leg.

WORD FORMATION:
{足|あし} (foot/leg) + {首|くび} (neck) = ankle
This follows a body part pattern:
- {手首|てくび}: wrist (hand-neck)
- {足首|あしくび}: ankle (foot-neck)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {足首|あしくび}を{捻|ひね}る: to twist one's ankle
- {足首|あしくび}を{回|まわ}す: to rotate one's ankle
- {足首|あしくび}が{腫|は}れる: ankle swells
- {足首|あしくび}の{怪我|けが}: ankle injury

RELATED:
- くるぶし: ankle bone (the protruding bone)
- {足|あし}: foot, leg
- {脚|あし}: leg (literary)

NOTE:
Ankle injuries are common in sports. {捻挫|ねんざ} (sprain) is a common diagnosis for twisted ankles.
